inlines.v: FE'ARFULNESS, noun 1. Timorousness; timidity. 2. State of being afraid; awe; dread. A thing that makes a government despised, is fearfulness of, and mean compliances with, bold popular offenders. 3. Terror; alarm; apprehension of evil. Fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Isaiah 33:14.
